name: CAPSTONE
about: CAPSTONE (2022-070A, ADVSP/ARC), launched 2022 Jun 28. Its phases from GCAT: Earth, SEL1, Luna. Orbits keep GCAT's shape and inclination; their orientation and the place along them are estimated.
